name: ailfred
description: Turns one oversized request — or an entire to-do list — into an approvable PRD, then into steps and tasks a worker can finish and prove, executed sequentially or in parallel git worktrees. Domain-agnostic: /ailfred, /ailfred-execute, /ailfred-status, four agents (architect, step runner, task worker, validator), decomposition and intake doctrine, and scripts for scaffolding, capability scan, checklist parsing and worktree lifecycle.
